bdf.distributions.NormalMuInvGammaSigmaNormal

class bdf.distributions.NormalMuInvGammaSigmaNormal(params)[source]

Bases: BDFDistribution[NormalMuInvGammaSigmaNormalParams]

Normal-Inverse-Gamma conjugate model (unknown mean and variance).

Usage: dist="NormalMuInvGammaSigmaNormal"

Model:

  • Prior: \(\mu \mid \sigma^2 \sim \mathcal{N}(\mu_0, \sigma^2/n_0)\), \(\sigma^2 \sim \text{InvGamma}(\nu_0/2, \nu_0 \phi_0/2)\)

  • Likelihood: \(y \mid \mu, \sigma^2 \sim \mathcal{N}(\mu, \sigma^2)\)

  • Posterior Predictive: \(y_\text{new} \mid y \sim t_{\nu_n}(\mu_n, \phi_n(1+1/n_n))\)

Parameters:

  • mu_mu (float, default=0.0) – Prior mean \(\mu_0\) for \(\mu\).

  • n_mu (float, default=1.0) – Prior precision scale \(n_0\). Acts as pseudo-sample-size weighting the prior mean.

  • nu_sigma (float, default=3.0) – Prior degrees of freedom \(\nu_0\) for \(\sigma^2\).

  • phi_sigma (float, default=1.0) – Prior scale parameter \(\phi_0\) for \(\sigma^2\).
